svg.title: Plant Spatial Omics Analysis workflow
svg.desc: Define comparison — Question, groups, bio_n — Unit and scope; Verify baseline — Actual layer and settings — Data and parameters; Compare options — Authorization gate — Run bounded / stop at plan; Audit retention — Denominators and exclusions — Missing is not zero; Record decision — Evidence and tradeoffs — Reuse limits
